businesses.business: Specialty fragrance and personal care retail

offering_description.value: Bath & Body Works sells body care, home fragrance, and hand soaps and sanitizers to consumers. It develops its own product lines, works with outside manufacturers, and sells through its stores, online shops, and international franchise partners.

primary_products.value: body lotions and creams; body washes; fragrance mists; scented candles and plug-in home fragrances; hand soaps and sanitizers

customer_segment.value: B2C: shoppers buying personal care, home fragrance, and gifts; B2B: international franchise and wholesale partners

end_markets.value: personal care; home fragrance; hand hygiene

revenue_model.value: product sales: retail purchases and merchandise sold to international partners; licensing or royalties: royalties from international franchise partners

value_chain_position.value: retailer: sources finished goods from manufacturing partners and sells them to consumers; brand owner: develops fragrance and personal care lines made by suppliers for shoppers and franchise partners

geography_served.value: global: United States and Canada, with franchise markets in Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: body care, home fragrance, hand soaps, and sanitizers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated stores in the United States and Canada; online: company and franchise partner online stores; partners / resellers: international franchise and wholesale partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA rules for cosmetics and hand sanitizers, consumer product safety rules for candles and home fragrance products
